title: Pricing capacity safeguards, release comms, and sales fallback scripting orchestration
creator: Asha Gupta
description: Coordinate launch activities for the upcoming pricing and packaging changes with a focus on capacity gating, billing communication sequencing, and practical sales fallback scripts. Produce a lightweight playbook for cross-functional teams (eng, billing, support, sales) that enumerates gating criteria, rollback triggers, and templated communications for customers and partners.
acceptance_criteria: Capacity gating criteria defined and automated check in staging and prod (>90% test coverage for gating scripts)
Billing migration emails and in-app notices approved by legal and sent to segmented cohorts at T-72h / T+24h
Sales: library of 6 fallback scripts covering quota disputes, prorating, and entitlement questions reviewed by Sales Ops
Release notes drafted, console banners prepared, and external API change log updated
On-call rotation and SLO rollback play defined with runbook links and runbook verified via tabletop exercise

Risk: Sales confusion around prorating — Mitigation: provide clear calculator + pre-written email templates and training session
